text: The five slowest lanes are North Sumatra > South Sulawesi (10.3997), Bali > North Sumatra (9.47461), North Sumatra > Bali (9.16411), Riau > South Sulawesi (8.79985), and South Sulawesi > Riau (8.69213). These lanes represent the highest average transit times, indicating a need to investigate potential bottlenecks or logistics inefficiencies along these specific routes.
